The dialect spoken in the northern Anglian Kingdom around the Humber estuary was Old Mercian, an Old English dialect associated with the Mercian Kingdom. This region, Lindsey, was on the southern and eastern banks of the Humber, influenced by both Old English and Old Norse due to Viking invasions in the Danelaw.

**Answer:** The dialect was Old Mercian, an Old English dialect spoken in the Anglian Kingdom of Lindsey, with possible Norse influences in the Danelaw.
